children: RBC Capital reiterated their Outperform rating on General Mills's stock with a price target of $45.00.
The price target implies an upside of 23.9% from the Sep 18 close of $36.32.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: General Mills has been investing heavily into its Remarkable Experience Framework, which is expected to yield a robust lineup of on-trend innovations, potentially driving top-line growth and improving North American retail trends.

: Despite facing challenges in the packaged food sector, General Mills is trading at a two-year forward P/E of approximately 11.4x, which is about 7% lower than the packaged food peer group average, suggesting an attractive valuation that supports an Outperform rating.
